purpose: Collect password credentials with reveal and hide control, optional live requirements, and match or mismatch feedback.

notes: Use VeliProvider for localized placeholders, visibility labels, requirement labels, and direction.

useWhen: A form collects a current, new, or confirmation password.
Password creation needs a live requirement checklist or success and mismatch feedback.

avoidWhen.situation: The value is not a credential.

supportedInteractions: Controlled or uncontrolled reveal and hide toggle
approvedPatterns: Use requirements for password creation and feedbackMessage for confirmation flows.
Use showRequirementsWhenEmpty, feedbackTone, and isSuccess for creation and confirm presentation.
Keep password validation in application logic; exported helpers can evaluate the same rules outside the field.
Use accessible visible labeling and explicit error feedback.
limitations: The built-in checklist only evaluates supplied client-side requirement functions.
Direct child composition, style overrides, and changing the input type are not supported.
When invalid, the error indicator replaces the visibility toggle.
accessibility: Uses React Aria TextField, Label, Input, and Button semantics.
The reveal control has localized show and hide labels and exposes its pressed state.
Required, disabled, read-only, and invalid states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: The field fills its container; keep requirement and feedback text within the same responsive column.
rtl: The surrounding field follows the active direction while the credential value and field shell remain LTR.
Localized labels and feedback remain direction-aware.
